folds.heading: ## Current-use reconciliation B119, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Full F1–F12/O1–O10/A1–A5 and correction table read. The audit sampled extracted first prompts, recaps and last replies from 49 Claude chats through its stated October 30 window; it did not read full transcripts or Codex chats. Preserve that evidence boundary. Its distinction between real test breaks and attributed load failures remains useful: an isolated pass or high load does not establish every failed test’s cause. Shared-index movement, overlapping writers, wrong-PID process termination and lost edits remain historical warnings, not newly observed incidents.

Several proposed actions are already reflected in actual owners. Current package.json routes npm test through slot_run with four workers, one suite slot and a bounded load wait; test:raw exists. F4/O2 no longer justify another default-limiter edit, and no config hook is selected here. Current game_mcp imports resolveCheckout and forks the selected worktree worker; checkout.mjs validates the repository and links absent shared inputs, as recorded in [GAME_MCP_LIMITS](../tools/GAME_MCP_LIMITS.md). F6/O5’s primary-only limitation is superseded at that named seam, not a fresh browser or floor pass. F12/O10’s exact instruction is now present in [USER_VISION](../USER_VISION.md#consider-similar-ideas-for-each-idea-where-relevant-2026-10-30); no duplicate direction record is needed.

The Nov1 credit deadline is past this review date. Quotas, sharded-read counts, 211-commit divergence, origin/pinned-app state and chapter coverage numbers are historical observations, not current facts or renewed urgency. O1/O7’s wave order and proposed ownership do not override current [PROJECT](../../PROJECT.md), AD51 shared-seam direction or the selected foundation writer’s M21/M22/M25 work. Do not duplicate its selected S9/foundation/checkpoint edits. Read-model-only and missing-consumer claims require per-feature current receipts, not blanket closure or blanket absence. F9’s defects and F10’s content gaps remain useful reproduction candidates, not all newly verified defects. No acquisition, source-reading wave, worktree launch, cherry-pick, hook installation, pinned-origin change or push is authorized by this report. A5’s silence/default language does not supply approval for a consequential action or an unaccepted proposal. Original history stays in place.
